title: Turkey's KVKK publishes 11 data breach notices, including ransomware cases
date_note: Memurlar.net says KVKK published the notices on 25 November 2026; the dates of the breaches themselves vary.
geo_basis: KVKK, the Turkish data protection authority, headquartered in Ankara; the notices cover several organisations
summary: According to Memurlar.net, Turkey's Personal Data Protection Authority (KVKK) published 11 separate breach notices on 25 November 2026. The article says three notices concern ransomware attacks and one a phishing email sent to an employee. It says five notices did not yet give a final count of people affected.
plain: Turkey's data protection authority published 11 breach notices from different organisations; the article says three concern ransomware attacks.
exec: Organisations handling Turkish residents' data are filing breach notices that KVKK publishes; the article reports three ransomware cases among them.
action: General advice: affected people can use their rights under Turkey's Law No. 6698; Memurlar.net says cardholders are advised to monitor card activity and replace their cards if needed.
impact: Memurlar.net says five notices did not yet give a final count of people affected.

evidence.quote: Kişisel Verileri Koruma Kurumu, 25 Kasım 2026 tarihinde 11 ayrı veri ihlali bildirimini internet sitesinde yayımladı.

validation.note: One publisher (Memurlar.net) relaying KVKK's notices; the KVKK page itself could not be read (certificate error).

review.note: Compared 11 notices, 3 ransomware, phishing, 5 without final count, date and card advice with Memurlar.net
